value.rationale: A complete exact finite-size dependence classification between local leaves and global triangle motifs under fixed-edge sampling, with a sharp m=n+1 transition for all n>=5 and opposite sign under independent-edge sampling, isolates an interpretable model-conditioning reversal. The precise sparse covariance limit crosses zero at average degree two (m/n=1), providing a useful benchmark for degree–motif dependence in random-network null models. This contrast and uniform cutoff are not a mere normalization or arbitrary finite parameter slice.
